tools.name: proworkflow_get_account
tools.description: Get the ProWorkflow account settings: plan, currency, time and look-and-feel settings. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /settings/account.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, with optional search and filters (status, company, manager, last modified). Use page_number and page_size for large accounts. API: GET /projects.

tools.name: proworkflow_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by ID. Sub-entities such as phases are returned only when named in fields. API: GET /projects/{projectid}.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_project_phases
tools.description: List the phases (item collections) of a project, with progress and financial metrics. API: GET /projects/{projectid}/phases.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_project_items
tools.description: List the items (tasks) of one project, with search and filters (status, priority, assigned contacts, tag). API: GET /projects/{projectid}/items.

tools.name: proworkflow_get_item
tools.description: Get the full details of one project item (task) by ID. API: GET /projects/items/{itemid}.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (clients, contractors and others), with search and filters. API: GET /companies.

tools.name: proworkflow_get_company
tools.description: Get one company by ID. API: GET /companies/{companyid}.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people: staff, client and contractor contacts), with search and filters. API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: proworkflow_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact (person) by ID. API: GET /contacts/{contactid}.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, with filters for company, project, status and dates (invoiced, due, paid). API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: proworkflow_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by ID, with its phases and line items. API: GET /invoices/{invoiceid}.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes, with filters for company, project, status and dates (quoted, last modified). API: GET /quotes.

tools.name: proworkflow_list_time_records
tools.description: List logged time, with filters for project, item, contact, company and dates. Without a date filter the API returns the last 6 days. API: GET /time.

tools.name: proworkflow_create_item
tools.description: Create a new item (task) in a project. Creates data in ProWorkflow. API: POST /projects/{projectid}/items.

tools.name: proworkflow_update_item
tools.description: Update the fields of one item (name, description, dates, priority, assignees, phase). Send only the fields to change. To complete an item, use proworkflow_complete_items. API: PUT /projects/items/{itemid}.

tools.name: proworkflow_complete_items
tools.description: Mark one or more items as complete. The API cannot reopen a completed item, so this change is final. API: PUT /projects/items/complete.

tools.name: proworkflow_add_time_record
tools.description: Log time spent on an item (task) by a contact. Creates data in ProWorkflow. API: POST /time.
